title: Fixing the Corrected Liability on a Restated Ridgecrest Advantage Claim Line
content:
The corrected liability on a claim line is what the member owes once the plan restates a line it has already adjudicated under a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan, and it is fixed this way on a line whose benefit category the plan held prices by a coinsurance; a line whose benefit category the plan held prices by a copay is outside this rule and is restated on the copay basis the plan's cost-share rules already fix for it.

### The quantities

- **The corrected liability on a claim line** is the amount after the deductible taken at the share of it the member meets, rounded to the nearest cent once at the end.
- **The amount after the deductible** is the plan allowed amount of the line the correction restates less the deductible taken out of that line, and is never less than nothing.
- **The plan allowed amount of the line the correction restates** is the plan allowed amount of the most recently processed claim line standing denied on the enrollment.
- **The deductible taken out of that line** is the annual medical deductible still unmet, or the plan allowed amount of the line where that is smaller.
- **The annual medical deductible still unmet** is the annual medical deductible of the plan held less the plan allowed amount of the in-network claim lines already adjudicated on the enrollment, and is never less than nothing.
- **The share of the amount after the deductible the member meets** is the coinsurance the plan held fixes for in-network outpatient surgery.
- **The distance remaining to the maximum out-of-pocket** is the maximum out-of-pocket the line is capped against less the cost share accumulated for the contract year, and is never less than nothing.
- **The maximum out-of-pocket the line is capped against** is the in-network maximum out-of-pocket of the plan held.
- **The cost share accumulated for the contract year** is the member cost share of every adjudicated claim line standing on the enrollment.

### What is charged

Where the amount after the deductible taken at the share of it the member meets is more than the distance remaining to the maximum out-of-pocket, only that distance remaining is charged. Where that figure is not more than the distance remaining, it is itself what the member owes. The rounding to the nearest cent is done once, on the figure reached at the end, and not on the parts as they are taken.

The corrected line carries the reference of the line it replaces and the coverage request that authorised the service, and amounts the member pays for services the plan does not cover at all never count toward the maximum out-of-pocket.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

Take a plan whose annual medical deductible is 300.00 USD, whose coinsurance for in-network outpatient surgery is 20 per cent and whose in-network maximum out-of-pocket is 5000.00 USD; an enrollment on which the in-network claim lines already adjudicated carry plan allowed amounts of 100.00 USD in all, and on which the cost share accumulated for the contract year is 4900.00 USD; and a most recently processed denied line whose plan allowed amount is 800.00 USD.

- Annual medical deductible still unmet: 300.00 USD less 100.00 USD, so 200.00 USD.
- Deductible taken out of that line: 200.00 USD, that being smaller than the plan allowed amount of 800.00 USD.
- Amount after the deductible: 800.00 USD less 200.00 USD, so 600.00 USD.
- Amount after the deductible taken at 20 per cent: 120.00 USD.
- Distance remaining to the maximum out-of-pocket: 5000.00 USD less 4900.00 USD, so 100.00 USD.
- The figure of 120.00 USD is more than that distance remaining, so only the distance remaining is charged and the corrected liability is **100.00 USD**.

On the same plan and the same line, an enrollment whose cost share accumulated for the contract year is 200.00 USD leaves a distance remaining of 4800.00 USD. The figure of 120.00 USD is not more than that, so the corrected liability is **120.00 USD**.
